leakage.scope: All nine source combinations; unique values per comparison; no leakage used for matching.

method.positive_sampling: all labeled pairs of proportional country-stratified uniform S1 sample; entity-clustered
method.hard_negative_method: top 3 nonmatches in uniform sampled same-country S2+S3 corpus, separately by name/address char TF-IDF
method.negative_truth_assumption: Ground truth is exhaustive for each S1; all listed matches excluded.
method.similarity_backend: Python exact normalized-Indel/token formulas; RapidFuzz package unavailable offline
method.tfidf: char_wb 3-5 grams; min_df=2; max_features=120000; float32; smoothed IDF; L2; fit uniform training target sample only
method.feature_scale: All similarities in [0,1]; numeric/postal features NaN when either side lacks tokens; equality excludes blank strings

blocking.rare_token_definition: Name token document frequency <=0.1% of full same-country combined S2+S3 corpus; no cap; all shared qualifying tokens
blocking.top_k_definition: K over combined S2+S3; strictly positive cosine; deterministic lexicographic ID tie-break. Vocabulary and IDF fitted to uniform target sample, retrieval searches every target.
